title: Supported File Formats in 3D Viewer
content: # **Objective** Learn about supported file formats in CLO-SET 3D Viewer. 1. [File Format](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153968537) # **Details** ### 1) File Format **Type** | **Format** | **Description** ---|---|--- Garment | *.zpac | Contains information on garments, patterns, sewing, and fabrics. Project | *.zprj | Compressed version of multiple files used for garment creation. The Project file contains the AVT file that has avatar-related data (Avatar, Accessories, Arrangement Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points, Avatar size, Poses), the ZPac file that contains garment-related data (3D Garments, 2D Patterns, Fabrics, subsidiary Material), as well as an animation file if there is any. Avatar | *.avt, .avte | Contains all the information related to Avatars (Model, Sizing data, Poses, Motions, Accessories, Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points). OBJ | *.obj | Contains geometry and material information. Primarily used for importing avatar and related sources into the program. GL Transmission Format | *gltf / glb | Contains scene and material information using the JSON standard. Primarily used for importing avatar and related sources into the program. COLLADA | *.dae | This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya, Pose, and DAZ Studio. These files contain geometry and material information, as well as rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting COLLADA files from 3ds Max or Maya, install “OpenCOLLADA plugin ([http://www.opencollada.org/download.html](http://www.opencollada.org/download.html)) and export to use the avatar Fabric | *.zfab | Contains the property values (texture + physical properties) of the set fabric. Button | *.btn | Contains the type, size, and color of Buttons. Buttonhole | *.bth | Contains the type, size, and color of the Buttonholes. Trim | *.trm | Contains material information Zipper Puller | *.zpl | Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Pullers. Zipper Slider | *.zsd | Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Sliders. Zipper Stopper | *.zsp | Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Stoppers. CAD file | *.dxf | Contains 2D CAD pattern and grading data. Used to import garment patterns from external CAD systems into CLO.
content_description: Discover the various supported file formats for CLO-SET 3D Viewer, including garment, project, and avatar types, along with their specific roles in garment creation and design.

title: Attachment
content: #### **Objective** Upload Attachments as a reference for your Content 1. Attach file from local PC 2. Attach file from OneDrive # **Details** ### 1) Attach file from local PC The Content Page supports attaching various files for the design development process. **[New Content Page]** Files such as images and PDFs can be uploaded using the **Upload File** button in the top-right corner or via drag and drop. You can also click **Add Link** to include reference URLs along with descriptions. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56807183532569) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56807203318169) **[Legacy Content Page]** From the Content page, click on the Attachment icon on the right pane. To upload a file from your local PC, click on 'Upload a file' on the top. > Please note that the attachment file size must be less than 500mb. ![Screenshot 2023-11-09 at 5.53.16 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778729251737) ### 2) Attach file from OneDrive ![Screenshot 2023-11-09 at 5.53.16 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778729251737) * You may also attach a file from your shared OneDrive folder * Click on 'OneDrive' button from the Attachment tab, and select the file you want to add. > Please note that OneDrive attachments are only supported on the legacy Content Page.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to guide users in uploading attachments from both their local PC and OneDrive to enhance their content development process.

title: Configurator
content:
#### Permission: ![Admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776461882649) Admin ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776436311961)Collaborator ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776404239001) Editor #### Supported File Type: zpac, zprj, zfab ## **Objective** Try CLO-SET Configurator to explore design options online. Instantly review different color, texture, and property options with your team. ![Configurator10.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776436997785) 1. Configurator: How-to 2. From your Dashboard, click the Content to open the Content page, where you can view the 3D Viewer. _Or, you can upload 3D files (zprj, zpac) to try the configurator._ ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54899247112601) 2\. From the **Content page** , confirm that the **3D Viewer** is selected, then click on the ![configurator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776405722009) **(Configurator) button** in the right-side **Create Mode bar**. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54899289169049)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54899289171097) _**💡 Notes**_ > **Access to the**![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54899289172889)**(New Configurator)****is available only for files that meet the requirement below. The icon will appear automatically when the conditions are satisfied.**
> > * Compatibility: Zprj/Zpac files saved on CLO 2024.1.244 or above
> 2\. When you click the **Configurator** button, the **Material List** appears in the top-left and the **Color/Texture/Property options panel** appears in the top-right. Then, select an item to edit from the **Material List.** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54899247118489) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54899289175449) ---|--- ###### 3\. Select a new option from the **Color/Texture/Property** tab, then click **Add Colorway** and **Save** to apply the changes. (When you click **Add Colorway** , the **Save** button appears.) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54906987617305) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54906987621401) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54906998764569) ---|---|--- 4\. New Colorway has been added under the 'Colorway' tab. Colorways added with CLO-SET Configurator will have the ![Icon Pack \(1\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776463660057)icon. * When you hover over the new Colorway, you can also find the **Delete** button in the top-right corner. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54899289177625)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54899247123225) ### 2) Color Editor * Pick a Color from palette to apply on your design * Reset the color by 'Reset color' button at the bottom * Click 'Create' to save the new colorway * Upload a [Color Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303194294425) to be shared with your team. **Picker** | **PANTONE** | **coloro** | **CUSTOM** ---|---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-08-04 at 4.51.16 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776421537817) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-04 at 4.51.27 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776454140569) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-04 at 4.51.38 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776464361881) | ![CUSTOM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776469977241) ### 3) Texture Editor ## ![Screenshot 2023-07-19 at 1.40.49 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776454757273) * Upload a Texture image * Adjust the texture using: * Gizmo on the style * Position/Scale/Rotation button on Configurator * Use Desaturation option * Reset Texture or Create new colorway ### 4) Property Editor ![Screenshot 2023-07-19 at 1.49.34 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776465069977) * Edit the Property of the file - Opacity, Roughness, Intensity, or Metalness * Click 'Reset Property' to reset it to match the original file * Click 'Create' to create a new colorway ### 5) Create New Version * Creating a new Version will help make the New Colorway(created with Configurator) compatible with all CLO-SET features. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776423191449) 1. **Add Colorway** : Create a new Colorway to be added on your Colorway list on the right pane. Colorways made with Configurator will have the ![Icon_Pack__1_.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776463660057) icon. 2. **Save** : After editing color, texture, or properties, click **Save**. Once saved, you can exit the **Configurator** tool and use other **3D Viewer** options (Exploded View, Schematic Render, etc.) for review. 3. **Create New Version** : Create a new [Version](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) including the new Colorways made with Configurator. Creating a new Version will help make the New Colorway compatible with all CLO-SET features. ![Picture1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776482977305) *Please note: for ZFAB files, you may only create a new version. Adding a new Colorway to the original file is unavailable. ### 6) Downloading the New Colorway Select 'All Colorways' option to download a new .ZPRJ file including both the 1) Colorway from your original content, and 2) new Colorways created with configurator (![Icon_Pack__1_.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776463660057)) ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776465404697) | ► | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776471201689) ---|---|--- * Choose the version you wish to download. **Hover over the version tab > click on ••• > select 'All Colorways'** * 'Original Content' option will only include colorways from your original zprj file * Upload the new zprj file to use: Render, Web Tech Pack, Line Sheet, Embed/Fitting ### 7) Best Practice Workflow ![configtable.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776483159321) * **3D Garment** : Create new Colorways with Configurator, and create new Version to create production materials such as Render and Tech Pack. * **Block Pattern** : Start from a block pattern to create new Colorways for a new season. * **ZFAB** : create new patterns or color options for an existing ZFAB file in CLO-SET.
content_description: Explore CLO-SET Configurator to effortlessly design and customize your 3D garments by reviewing various color, texture, and property options in real-time with your team.

title: Custom View
content:
## **Objective** Understand how to use the custom view feature on CLO-SET. 1. What is Custom View? 2. Selecting Custom view option on CLO-SET Space / Dashboard 3. Selecting Custom view option on CLO-SET Content page 4. Selecting Custom view option on CLO Software ## **Details** #### **1) What is Custom View?** Custom View is a function in CLO3D that allows you to save a certain Viewpoint. Link to [Custom View](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115004420828-Custom-View) CLO3D. In CLO-SET, now we support thumbnail image and turntable images based on the Custom View. > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is available only for .**zprj files** as the Custom View data is only saved
> > for **.zprj file** > 💡 **Note:** Custom View is applied to anywhere utilizing thumbnail features, including **Linesheet** ,
> > **Visual Board** , **Web Tech Pack** and any other thumbnail images in CLO-SET. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47460161161369) #### **2) Selecting Custom View option on CLO-SET Space / Dashboard** In the Space and Dashboard areas of CLO-SET, you can select the "Custom View as Thumbnail" option when uploading a file. ![Body.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47482755327129) #### **3)****Selecting Custom View option on CLO-SET Content page** 1. 'Custom View' option is also available on the Content page of CLO-SET. By selecting Version Update on the Content page and choosing a single file, you can select the "Custom View as Thumbnail" function option.![Body.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47487698939673) 2. By selecting 'Create New Version' on the Colorway tab, you can select the "Custom View as Thumbnail" function option. [New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56800028109337) [Legacy Content Page]![Body1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47487698940825) #### **4)****Selecting Custom View option on CLO Software** 1. When directly uploading from CLO software to CLO-SET, you can also use the Custom View function. By clicking the CLO-SET tab at the top, you can select either "Upload to CLO-SET" or "Render via CLO-SET." At this point, on the CLO-SET screen that appears, you can activate the function by clicking "Use Custom View as Thumbnail" toggle. * If the file does not have a custom view, this toggle will not be activated. ![Body2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47489108621977) 2. In the CLO software, you can access User Settings to configure options related to version updates. Here, you can enable the "Custom View as Thumbnail" function, which allows you to apply the custom view feature when working on a file imported from the CLO-SET library and performing an immediate version update. This operates independently of the Custom View Thumbnail function on the Direct Upload (Share via CLO-SET) described earlier. ![Body3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47489108625945)
content_description: This web page aims to provide a comprehensive guide on utilizing the Custom View feature in CLO-SET, including its definition, application across various platforms, and step-by-step instructions for selecting and using it effectively.

title: Global Unit Setting (Measurement & Currency)
content:
## **Objective** Understand Global Unit (Measurement & Currency) Setting. 1. What is Global Unit Setting 2. Managing global unit inconsistencies 3. Default Currency in Web Tech Pack / Content Page / Linesheet ## ## **Details** #### **1) What is Global Unit Setting?** Global Unit setting is an unified management of currency & measurement units at the company level. * From the left pane, click Browse > Company, then go to Settings ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54985562648601) | | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54985578474009) ---|---|--- * In Settings, you can configure the Global Unit (Measurement & Currency) on the General Tab. It applies to the 2D Pattern Viewer and is synchronized with the Content Custom Field (Length) and Web Tech Pack (BOM, POM, and Cost Estimation tabs). ![ddd.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47495014053529)💡 **Note** > Global Unit Setting is applied at the company level.
> > User with **'Company Admin'** or '**Group Admin'** permission can modify these options. #### **2) Managing Global Unit Inconsistency** If the unit set in Company Settings differs from the unit of the file, a Modal will appear, indicating which unit is different. This modal is displayed in the following four cases: 1\. Mismatch when versioning up file 2\. Mismatch when uploading file 3\. Mismatch when updating tech pack version 4\. Mismatch when adding BOM item to the table #### **3) Unit Synchronization** Unit set in Company Settings is synchronized across various domains in CLO-SET. In the Web Tech Pack, the Global Unit is synchronized and displayed in the **"Overview"** , "**BOM"** and **"Cost Estimation"** tabs. 1\. Web Tech Pack Unit Synchronization Measurement Unit and Price Unit data are synchronized and displayed, with the price unit shown as the **"default currency"** in the top right corner. ![111.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519362877721) If the price unit differs, both the **"default currency"** and the **"file currency"** are displayed simultaneously in the top right corner. ![222.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519362878233) ![17.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519878308633) 2\. The default currency is also displayed on the 'Content Page' and the 'Linesheet'. [New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799846076313)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56799846078617) [Legacy Content Page]![ㅁㅇㄹㅇㅁㄴㄹ.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519868822297) [Linesheet] ![ㅎㅎㅎㅎㅎ.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/47519878310809)
content_description: This web page aims to provide a comprehensive guide on configuring and managing Global Unit (Measurement & Currency) Settings to ensure consistency across company operations in CLO-SET.

title: Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload)
content: #### Permission(in CLO-SET Group): ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778310726937) Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778310936217)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778311077273)Editor, ![Viewer.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778330948505)Viewer with Upload # **Objective** You can directly upload a 3D project file including or excluding garment/avatar from CLO Software to CLO-SET. You may also easily run Render or generate Excel Tech Pack via CLO-SET. 1. Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload) 2. Render via CLO-SET 3. Tech Pack via CLO-SET **Details** ### 1) Share via CLO-SET (Direct Upload) 1\. 'Share via CLO-SET' from CLO Software. **Option 1** | **Option 2** ---|--- File > Share via CLO-SET ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778354185241) | Main Menu ▶ ![blobid0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778354297113) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778345303577) 2\. Once your file is ready to upload, click 'OK'. If you are not signed into CLO-SET yet, you will be directed to Sign In page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778345528985) 3\. Choose the Group/Location in which you want to upload the file, or select an existing file in CLO-SET for a version update. **![directupload.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778354908825)** * 1) Select the Group you want to upload the file to * 2) You may choose whether or not you want to notify collaborators in your Group. You may also choose to apply Auto Numbering for CLO-SET to automatically name the content. * 3) Upload a new content to an existing Workroom. Click '+MORE' to view the full list. * User must have an upload permission to select Workroom. (permissions: Admin, Collaborator, Editor, or Viewer with Upload) * Click '+MORE' to view the 'Browse' tab. Only the Spaces to which you have upload permission will be displayed. * 4) Version update an existing content. Select an existing content from your CLO-SET space, and upload the file as a newer version (ex. version 2) instead of a separate content. 4\. Final view in CLO-SET * For Project/Garment/Avatar upload, you will see the 3D viewer in CLO-SET [New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56791473148953) [Legacy Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56791446028313) * * * ### 2) Render via CLO-SET * For**Render via CLO-SET** , once the file is uploaded, Render will start automatically. Learn more about CLO-SET Render [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207203225). *Rendering will be done per your Render Settings in CLO [New Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56791473168793) [Legacy Content Page] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56791473180441) * ### 3) Tech Pack via CLO-SET * For **Tech Pack via CLO-SET,** once the file is uploaded, Excel Tech Pack will be downloaded automatically. Learn more about Excel Tech Packs [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303163374105). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778346436633)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778355784601) For more information on how to link your CLO-SET account in CLO, click [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191662617).
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on how to upload 3D project files, render images, and generate Excel Tech Packs using CLO-SET, ensuring users can efficiently manage their garment and avatar projects.

title: Workroom View
content:
# **Objective** Learn how to navigate CLO-SET Dashboard and utilize your Workroom Space ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992629223449) 1. Menus (Left Pane) 2. Space (Room View) 3. Comment, Share (Right Pane) 4. Content Interaction & Movement # **Details** ### 1) Menus (Left Pane) ![Screenshot 2023-11-10 at 1.54.49 PM copy.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777975520921) | ![Screenshot 2023-11-10 at 3.15.16 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778005716249) ---|--- **1\. Group Name** : See which Group you're currently in. To switch the Group, click on the downward arrow (⌄) next to the Group's name. The Blue Crown indicates that you are the Group Admin. **2\. Menu Tab** * Browse: View the space [hierarchy](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) and navigate to the desired Space * Workspace: View all Spaces by level. (ex. Click on 'Companies' to view all Company Space you have access to) * Console: View [Admin Console](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721) for usage data, billing, and developer page. * [Favorites](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219472153): View all Spaces and Contents you've marked as Favorite * [Search](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161): Search Contents using everyday words or an image. ### 2) Space (Room View) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992629224217) **3\. Space Info** * Upload: Upload a new Content in current Workroom * Create: Create a sub-Space * Notifications: Turn notifications on/off for current Space * [Favorite](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219472153): Mark/unmark the Space as Favorite * Navigation: Shows the hierarchy of the Space you are in **4.**[**Line Sheet**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289)** & **[**Data Intelligence**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303278347545) **5\. Space Name** : Name of the Space you are in (Brand | Workroom) **6.**[**Search Bar**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161): Search Contents within the Space **7.**[**Filter**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049)**:** Filter the Contents you want to view 8\. View by: Shows by each content or clorway ### 3)Comment, Share (Right Pane) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54992573410713) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777990897561) #### **Share to People** * [**Invite/Share**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303179603481): Invite or share with teammates * Invite: for Company/Brand * Share: for Workroom/Content * **Share with Link:** Turning this option on will convert the Space to public status. Be ware of the security implications when sharing with link. * **Accessible People** : View the list of teammates with access to this Space. This may include those with access to higher-level Spaces. For example, anyone with access to a Brand will be able to view all Workroom within the Brand. _**💡 Notes**_ > Download access for link-shared content (share with link) is limited to **Group Members only**. > Anyone with the link can still **view** , but only **Group Members can download** , even when **Enable Download** is turned on. #### **Workroom Comment** * Commenting is also available at the [Workroom](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697). Please follow the hyperlink to view detailed Permissions. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777999005209) ### 4)Content Interaction & Movement #### 4-1) Selection Interaction (Single Click / Double Click) CLO-SET separates **item selection** and **page navigation** to prevent unintended actions. * **Single click** → Select item * **Double click** → Open item and navigate to its page ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393864050585) _**💡 Notes**_ > In the **Workroom** , a single click also allows you to **preview key content information** without opening the content page, making it easier to review details while browsing multiple contents.
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56790941711257)
> > [Content information in the new Content Page UI]
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56790941718553)
> > [Content information in the Legacy Content Page UI]
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56790934806041) #### 4-2) Basic Selection Behavior #### Single Selection **Option** | **Description** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)x2 | Double click on an item: opens the item ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)x1 | Single click on an item: selects the item * Previously selected item will be deselected **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)**x1 | Single click on empty space: deselects all items * Applied to **all areas except Assortment, Dashboard, and Visual Board** #### #### Multi Selection (Workroom only) **Option** | **Description** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880017433) | Mouse left Button Drag from empty space to select multiple items Ctrl(Cmd) +**![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)** | Add or remove items from the selection * Mac : Command / Window : Control * Previously selected items will remain selected. * Selecting an already-selected item again will deselect it. Shift + **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)** | Select a range of items * adds all items between the most recently selected item and the currently selected item to the selection. ***** Multi-selection is supported **only in the Workroom (Content area)** **📝 Note** 1. **Context Menu** * The (…) button is disabled even when an item is selected. * Even if multiple items were previously selected, the selection will be cleared and only one item will remain selected. 2. **Popover Menu** * If a Workroom is included in the selection list, all actions except _deselect_ will be disabled. #### 4-3) Drag&Drop Move for Selected Contents Once contents are selected, they can be moved more efficiently using **drag &drop** interactions. #### #### Drag into a Workroom * Single or multiple selected contents can be dragged directly into a **Workroom** * The contents will be moved to the target location ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880019609) #### #### Drag via Top Breadcrumb Navigation * Selected contents can be dragged to the **top breadcrumb navigation** * When hovering over a higher-level location, a **“+” indicator** appears, allowing the contents to be dropped and moved. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393864062361)
content_description: Discover how to effectively navigate the CLO-SET Dashboard and maximize your Workroom Space for enhanced collaboration and content management.

title: Render Preset (Standardize Rendering)
content:
# **📝 List of Contents** 📍 Learn how to use [Render Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) feature to standardize the Rendering results within the team. * What is Render Preset? * Upload Render Preset in CLO-SET * Using Render Preset * Render Preset Properties created inCLO # **📓 Details** **• What is Render Preset?** --- * Render Preset helps **standardize** the Render Properties for a cohesive output generation ![CLO-SET_Default_2024.1.256_for Colorway Compatibility_Butter.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778065909017)![CLO-SET_Default_2024.1.256_for Colorway Compatibility_Velvet Pink.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778066040217)![CLO-SET_Default_2024.1.256_for Colorway Compatibility_Grey.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778103367833)![CLO-SET_Default_2024.1.256_for Colorway Compatibility_Blue.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778082594841) * Render Preset allows users to apply **detailed****Render Properties** when Rendering in CLO-SET[ ](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) in CLO3D [![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778066869657)](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) | ▶ | in CLO-SET [![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778103990937)](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) ---|---|--- **• Upload Render Preset (.ZVRP) in CLO-SET** --- * From the left pane, click Browse > Company, then go to Settings > Rendering to Add/Edit/Delete Render Preset. * Click **Upload File** to add a Render Preset. * You can **Add / Edit / Delete** presets here. * Up to **32 preset files** can be uploaded. * [Please note: Company Settings are accessible to Company Admin only](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978742878105) | | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978742878873) ---|---|--- _**💡 Note – How to Create a Render Preset File (ZVRP) From CLO Software**_ > Before uploading to CLO-SET, you need to create a **ZVRP (Render Preset) file** from **CLO software.**
> > ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778083250457) | ► | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778083552153) > ---|---|--- > > * On CLO3D software, adjust Render properties per your needs on the Property Editor
> * Once you are done, click **Save As > Render Properties** to save as **ZVRP** file
> * The saved ZVRP includes Image/Video, Camera, Light, and Render properties
> * A few requirements for CLO-SET:
> * Image count for Turntable must be less than 64
> * Image size must be less than 5,000px
> * Animation type can not be rendered
> * *Please note: If you select the 'Current View' option from CLO3D, CLO-SET Render will be based on the last view each user sees on their CLO-SET 3D Viewer. is used to design and create garments in 3D, while **CONNECT** is the marketplace for buying and selling avatars, garments, and digital assets. > **CLO-SET** then brings these assets together into a collaborative workspace for managing, reviewing, sharing, and seamlessly carrying them through merchandising and production.
> **• Using Render Preset** --- * From your Dashboard, click the Content to open the Content page, where you can view the 3D Viewer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978742879769) * Select the options as per needed, and **click 'Render'** to create Render (_Learn more about_[ _Render Settings_](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207203225)) > _**Render on the Content Page**_
> > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56495264357657)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56495264358681)
> > * In **New** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56495249963161)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56495249964057)
> > * On your Content Page, click on Render to select the Render Settings. * On the drop-down menu, you will see the **Company Preset** (with ![company.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778084170905) icon) > _**Select Render Preset on the Content Page**_
> > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978753788057)
> > * In **New** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56495249965081)
> > _**💡 Note**_ > Once you select the Company's Render Preset option, you can not change the Render Settings. You may check the Property details by clicking on the 𝒊 icon of the preset.
> > ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978753789337) | ► | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778103990937) > ---|---|--- **•**[**Render Preset Properties created in CLO**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) --- * #### To view the full list of properties saved in a ZVRP file from CLO, please visit [**Render Preset Guide**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) [![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778119339929)](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on utilizing the Render Preset feature in CLO-SET to standardize rendering results for cohesive team outputs.

title: Copy Space Structure
content: #### **Permission** : may vary per scenario. Please see below. # **Objective** With this feature, you can easily replicate the Space Structure to prepare for a new season. 1. Copy Space Structure 2. Copy Company 3. Copy Brand 4. Copy Line/Season 5. Additional Notes # **Details** ### 1) Copy Space Structure * Simply copy any Space from Company to Season along with sub-level Spaces up to the 1st-depth Workroom. * Only the Space Hierarchy will be copied, **NOT** including the Contents within the original Space. ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.09.29 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778491077529) * **Basics:** * Go to 'Browse' menu or 'Workspace' to find the Space you want to Copy * On the upper-right corner of the Space, click ••• then click 'Copy Space Structure' * Insert the name of the new Space, and click 'Confirm' * **Only the Space Structure will be copied** without Contents, Categories, and Workflows ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.28.31 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778475909017) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55008522309145) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778476467737) ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.28.41 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778492075033) ### 2) Copy Company Structure **Permission** : Group Admin only * Go to Workspace > Companies to select the Company to Copy * Click on ••• on the upper-right corner of the Company > click 'Copy Space Structure' * Type in the name of the new Space, and click 'Confirm' * Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Company Space. * You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu * The new Company Space will replicate all Company Settings of the original Company. ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.42.51 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778477146521) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.25.09 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778476219673) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.45.52 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778492822681) ---|---|--- ### 3) Copy Brand Structure **Permission** : Group Admin, Company Admin * Option 1: Go to 'Browse' > and select the Company within which the Brand is located * Option 2: Go to 'Workspace' > Brands * Click on ••• on the upper-right corner of the Brand > click 'Copy Space Structure' * Type in the name of the new Brand, and select where you want the new Brand to be * You may only choose between Company Spaces you have permission to * Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Brand Space. * You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.55.03 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778492992537) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.52.03 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778478042521) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.53.44 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778493487513) ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.55.24 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778493748505) ### ### 4) Copy Line/Season Structure **Permission** : Group Admin, Company Admin, Company Collaborator, Brand Admin * Option 1: Go to 'Browse' > and select the Brand within which the Line/Season is located * Option 2: Go to 'Workspace' > Lines/Seasons * Click on ••• on the upper-right corner of the Line/Season > click 'Copy Space Structure' * Type in the name of the new Space, and select where you want the new Line/Season to be * You may only choose between Brand Spaces you have permission to * Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Space. * You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 8.05.27 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778478952601) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55010152983193) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.53.44 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778493487513) ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 8.04.12 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778494800921) ### 5) Additional Notes Please mind that the Copy Space Structure: * only copies the Space Hierarchy, **NOT** the Contents within * copying the Space between Groups is unavailable * copying Workroom/Assortment level Spaces is unavailable * Space creation or duplication may be limited depending on your plan. If you reach the limit, an “Upgrade Your Plan” pop-up will appear as shown below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55008522319513)
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for users on how to efficiently replicate Space Structures for new seasons, detailing permissions required and procedures for copying spaces, companies, brands, and lines/seasons within the platform.

title: Strain Map on 3D Viewer
content: Compatible with Contents uploaded post **December 6th, 2023** # **Objectives** With this update, you can view the garment Strain map as done in CLO3D. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55009655280281) 1. Strain Map in Content Page * Compatibility 2. What is Strain Map? # **Details** ### 1) Strain Map in Content Page In the Content Page, click the 'Strain Map' icon, or use shortcut key (Shift + 7) Once Strain Map is activated, you can find the Tightness Range bar on the top right. #### **[Strain Map Compatibility]** * Content must have been uploaded after **December 6th, 2023**. If you see below error message, please re-upload the file to view Strain Map. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778307250457) * Strain Map is only applied to garments, not avatars. * Strain Map is **NOT** compatible with: * Garment Rendering Style Group * Schematic Render * Render * Configurator * Filter ### 2) What is Strain Map? ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778307394329) Strain Map displays the distortion rate from 2D patterns to 3D patterns. This view is the same as CLO3D's ['Strain Map'](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/articles/115012227287-Strain-Map) view in 'Monochrome' mode. * (3D pattern size / 2D Pattern size * 100)% Blue: 100% distortion, which means no distortion keeping the original pattern stretch Red: 120% distortion. The higher the rate is, the more distortion there are between 2D & 3D patterns. You may adjust the pattern placement/size based on the Strain Map data.
content_description: Discover how to utilize the new Strain Map feature for garments in your content uploaded after December 6th, 2023, to visualize distortion rates between 2D and 3D patterns.
